name: Succotash
description: Historical recipe from The Canadian Family Cook Book (1914). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: string beans cut in pieces
ingredients.originalText: 1 pint string beans cut in pieces

instructions.text: Cut the corn from the cob, bruising as little as possible.
Put over the fire with the beans in enough hot water, salted, to cover them, and stew gently half an hour.
Turn off nearly all the water and add a cupful of milk.
Simmer in this, stirring to prevent burning, twenty minutes; add the floured butter, the pepper and salt, and stew ten minutes.

source.author: Grace E. Denison
source.originalInstructions:
1. Cut the corn from the cob, bruising as little as possible.
2. Put over the fire with the beans in enough hot water, salted, to cover them, and stew gently half an hour.
3. Turn off nearly all the water and add a cupful of milk.
4. Simmer in this, stirring to prevent burning, twenty minutes; add the floured butter, the pepper and salt, and stew ten minutes.
5. Serve in a deep dish.
originalIngredients: 1 pint string beans cut in pieces
